messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-314159 fired for service 'inference-eu-prod'. Priority: P1. Assigned to @alice (oncall). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-314159
alice: acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it. Brief: increased 99p latency on embeddings queue in eu-west-1.
deploy-bot: no recent deploys in last 6h.
emma: support report — Customer 42 seeing timeouts in chat widget, multiple error reports from EU region.
alice: running quick checks: `curl -sS http://health.inference-eu.internal/metrics | jq '.queue.depth, .latency.p99'`
alice: output: queue.depth=780, latency.p99=1.2s, error.rate=0.8% (baseline ~0.02%)
sophia: looking at runtime metrics — KV cache hitrate dropped sharply around 11:12 UTC. Possible cache eviction or node restart.
raj: can we confirm if autoscaler removed pods around that time?
alice: checking autoscaler logs... `kubectl logs -n infra autoscaler-5f8d --tail=200` -> shows scaleDown at 11:10 due to cpu threshold.
sophia: that aligns. scale-down removed two GPU pods serving embeddings, making long runs queue up and cold-starts hit.
alice: mitigation plan: 1) scale up eu pool 2) enable temporary routing to a smaller quantized model variant to reduce latency 3) revise scaleDown cooldown.
alice: runbook: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/queue-backpressure
raj: manually increasing replicas in eu pool: `kubectl scale deployment inference-eu --replicas=12 -n inference` — executing now.
alice: enabling fallback routing: `redwoodctl routes set --region eu --fallback-model small-quantized-v2 --weight 30` — applied.
emma: support update to Customer 42: "We're investigating, temporarily routing to a lighter model to restore responsiveness. ETA ~10m." :pray:
sophia: metrics after changes: queue.depth -> 220, p99 -> 420ms. KV hitrate recovering.
oncall-ops: :thumbsup: good quick mitigation. Any model load errors?
sophia: small-quantized-v2 warmed fine, no load errors. Good to go.
alice: handing ownership to raj for scaling follow-up and postmortem. Raj — taking handoff?
raj: taking it. I'll own until recovered and a postmortem is drafted.
alice: notes recorded: suspected root cause = aggressive scaleDown threshold + KV cache eviction due to memory pressure. Short-term mitigation = adjust scaleDown cooldown, prewarm pods, and fallback routing.
raj: opening incident doc and assigning action items. tagging @sophia for model-platform changes.
alice: customer impact summary: ~12% of EU requests experienced >1s latency and ~0.6% timeouts/5xx over a ~20m window. Affected customers: Customer 42 (ticket #12345), Customer 77 (alerts).
emma: added CRM notes and sent targeted customer updates.
raj: will monitor and post status pings every 10m until stable.
alice: reassigning PagerDuty ownership to raj. :white_check_mark:
pagerbot: PagerDuty: INC-314159 acknowledged by alice, reassigned to raj.
sophia: follow-up action: increase KV cache memory in eu config and add a prewarm hook on scale up. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/888
raj: incident doc created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-314159 — adding timeline and RCA.
alice: closing criteria: 1h stable p99 under threshold and no customer escalations.
raj: current snapshot: p99=290ms, queue.depth=50, error.rate~0.01%. continuing monitoring.
emma: confirmation to Customer 42: "Service returned to normal; engineering working on root cause and RCA. We'll follow up with details." Customer replied :thumbsup:.
alice: follow-up postmortem action owners: scale policy (raj), kv cache tuning (sophia), prewarm hook (sophia), alert threshold tuning (alice).
raj: pinging in 10m with next status update.
sophia: suggestion for PM: add synthetic probe for queue length to alert earlier before p99 climbs.
pagerbot: system note: auto-escalation timer cleared; no further pages for INC-314159."
